_comment: 由 sync_translation.py 维护，请勿手改。记录上次确认时每个已翻译键的英文原文。

line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_all_npcs_hint: Lists every NPC the game keeps in memory, including the ones that aren't loaded. Scanning can take a moment.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_config_entry_blacklisted: This NPC is on the config's NPC blacklist, which is checked before saved presets.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_config_entry_removed: Removed from the config. This NPC keeps their current body.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_config_entry_same: The config always gives this NPC this preset.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_config_entry_saved: Saved in the config. This NPC always gets this preset.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_config_leveled: This NPC was spawned from a leveled list, so the config can't name them.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_config_no_preset: Pick a preset for this NPC first.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_config_player: Writes your character's current preset to the in-game config file, so the config gives it to them whenever their preset is picked again, such as with Re-roll preset. The Include Files tab shows that file.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_config_remove_hint: The NPC keeps their current body, the config just stops giving them a preset.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_config_save_hint: Writes this NPC's current preset to the in-game config file, so the config gives it to them. The Include Files tab shows that file.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_config_tree_header: The config in use, all files merged:
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_bl_class_hint: NPCs of this class get no preset from OBody, unless a rule for specific NPCs or names gives them one.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_bl_npc_name_hint: NPCs with this name never get a preset from OBody. You can still pick one for them in the OBody menu.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_bl_npc_record_hint: These NPCs never get a preset from OBody. You can still pick one for them in the OBody menu.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_bl_plugin_hint: NPCs from this plugin get no preset from OBody, unless a rule for specific NPCs or names gives them one.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_bl_preset: Presets left out of random picks
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_bl_preset_hint: These presets are never picked at random. Rules can still give them, and you can pick them in the OBody menu.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_bl_race_hint: NPCs of this race get no preset from OBody, unless a rule for specific NPCs or names gives them one.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_change_hint: Your version of this rule goes to the in-game config file and replaces this one.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_class_hint: NPCs of this class get one of the presets listed, unless a rule above already gave them one.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_delete_hint: The rule from the other file applies again.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_drag_hint: Drag up or down to change the order.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_faction_hint: NPCs in this faction get one of the presets listed, unless a Specific NPCs or NPCs by name rule already gave them one. Factions higher in the list have priority, so if an NPC is in several of these factions, the one that comes first in this list is used.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_group_fold: Click to hide the rules under this title.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_group_unfold: Click to show the rules under this title.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_merge_failed: The config files couldn't be read:
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_move_down: Move down: this rule gets checked after the one below it.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_move_failed: This rule couldn't be moved, so the order is unchanged.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_move_up: Move up: this rule gets checked before the one above it.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_need_target: Pick what the rule is for first.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_npc_name_hint: Every NPC with this name gets one of the presets listed. Checked after the Specific NPCs rule.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_npc_record_hint: These NPCs get one of the presets listed for them. This rule is checked before all the other rules.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_orefit_off_name_hint: ORefit leaves NPCs wearing an outfit with this name as they are, as if they wore nothing.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_orefit_off_plugin: Outfits from a plugin without ORefit
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_orefit_off_plugin_hint: ORefit leaves NPCs wearing outfits from this plugin as they are, as if they wore nothing.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_orefit_off_record_hint: ORefit leaves NPCs wearing these outfits as they are, as if they wore nothing.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_orefit_on_name: Outfits that always get ORefit, by name
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_orefit_on_name_hint: ORefit always changes the body of NPCs wearing an outfit with this name, whatever slot it uses.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_orefit_on_record_hint: ORefit always changes the body of NPCs wearing these, whatever slot they use.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_plugin_down: Move this plugin down. Its outfits get checked after the outfits of the plugin below.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_plugin_drag_hint: Drag up or down to move this plugin with its outfits.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_plugin_hint: NPCs added or changed by this plugin get one of the presets listed, unless a Specific NPCs, NPCs by name, Factions or Classes rule already gave them one. Plugins higher in the list have priority, so if an NPC is added or changed by several of these plugins, the one that comes first in this list is used.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_plugin_move_failed: This plugin couldn't be moved, so the order is unchanged.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_plugin_up: Move this plugin up. Its outfits get checked before the outfits of the plugin above.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_race_hint: NPCs of this race get one of the presets listed, when no other rule gave them one.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_read_failed: The in-game config file can't be edited, it couldn't be read:
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_refit_keyword_hint: Outfits with these keywords use the "<Preset>-Refit <Keyword>" presets. Keywords higher in the list have priority, so if what an NPC wears has several of these keywords, the one that comes first in this list is used.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_refit_name: Refit presets for outfits, by name
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_refit_name_hint: NPCs wearing an outfit with this name get these -Refit presets. Outfits higher in the list have priority, so if an NPC wears several of these outfits, the one that comes first in this list is used. Outfits listed by record are checked before these.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_refit_record_hint: NPCs wearing this outfit get these -Refit presets. The outfits are grouped by the plugin they come from. If an NPC wears several of these outfits, the plugin higher in the list wins, and inside a plugin, the outfit higher in the list wins.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_switch_off_hint: The in-game config file removes this rule. The file it comes from stays as it is.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_editor_untrimmed: The config can't hold a name that starts or ends with a space.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_highlight_force_application_immed: Due to a Racemenu/SSE Engine Fixes bug, sometimes the preset application from the preset list menu is not visually immediate. OBody works around this by redressing the main outfit piece of the character, which forces the new body morphs to apply immediately. If you don't like the visual effect this causes, turn this option off.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_highlight_genitals: Randomizes genitals with procedural generation. Supposedly only works in CBBE 3BA body.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_highlight_legacy_storage_util_usa: Before version 4.4.0 of OBody NG, the preset assigned to an NPC was saved using only StorageUtil. Now, OBody NG stores the preset assignment to its own SKSE cosave. For backwards compatibility with mods that read the preset assignment saved using StorageUtil, preset assignments are still saved using StorageUtil when this option is enabled. Disabling this option will reduce the size of your saves slightly, but may cause incompatibilities with older mods.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_highlight_nipple: Randomizes nipples with procedural generation. Supposedly only works in CBBE based bodies.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_highlight_nipple_sliders_orefit: If you get sunken or weird nipples/areolas with ORefit, turn off this option to alleviate the problem. Character redressing is required for this to take effect.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_highlight_performance_mode: With performance mode enabled, you may see body morphs being applied to the NPCs when you meet them for the first time, which can look jarring. However, this happens very rarely, and only when you meet them for the first time! Performance mode enabled may also result in frequent crashes, please refer to the mod page for more information. If you turn off Performance Mode, it may result in stutters/FPS dips in large mod lists or older hardware setups. It is recommended to keep it off for most cases.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_highlight_preset_key: Set the key which shows the menu of all installed presets.\nIf an NPC is in your crosshair, it will apply the preset to the NPC. If an NPC is NOT in your crosshair, it will apply the preset to your Player Character.\nSet to Esc to unbind.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_highlight_refit: Makes it so that when an actor is clothed, sliders are changed to simulate the effect clothes have on the different body parts. Works fine with CBBE and UNP based bodies, including CBBE 3BA and BHUNP from my tests. Disable if you get weird results. Character redressing is required for changes to this setting to take effect.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_highlight_reset_distribution: Reset the presets that have been distributed to NPCs. This will respect the rules you set in the JSON configuration. Please do this on a cell with no other NPCs or with as few NPCs as possible, such as a player home. Also please note this will only take effect after you save and then reload the game.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_include_files_ingame: The changes made in game are saved to
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_include_files_ingame_last: It always loads after the other files, whatever their names, so the changes made in game win over them.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_include_files_ingame_missing: It doesn't exist yet: it's created the first time a change is saved in game. It always loads after the other files, whatever their names, so the changes made in game win over them.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_include_files_rule: Include files load in alphabetical order, ignoring upper and lower case. When two files set the same thing, the file loaded later wins.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_message_performance_mode:
Performance mode will be enabled. This might result in more frequent crashes. Refer to the mod page for more info.

It is NOT recommended to turn on Performance Mode unless you know what you are doing.

If you want to proceed, click Accept.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_message_reset_distribution:
All presets that have been distributed to NPCs will be reset. Your JSON configuration rules will be respected.

PLEASE do this on a cell with no other NPCs or with as few NPCs as possible, such as a player home or even a dungeon.

You will need to save and exit the game afterwards. Do you want to proceed?
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_message_reset_distribution_succes: OBody NG will reset the presets that have been distributed.\n\n PLEASE SAVE THE GAME AND EXIT THE GAME NOW! Then start Skyrim and reload your save again. This is needed for the reset to work!
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_preset_list_failure: A critical error has occurred while parsing the Bodyslide presets files. This most likely means you have a corrupt bodyslide preset, or a bodyslide preset where the name contains special/incompatible characters. As a result, the presets list in the OBody menu will be empty. Please exit the game now and refer to the OBody NG mod page for more information.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_preview_unloaded: This NPC isn't loaded, so there's no preview. The preset you pick is applied when they load.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_racemenu_failure: Critical error: OBody NG couldn't connect to RaceMenu, therefore OBody won't work. Please make sure RaceMenu is installed, enabled, and that it is the correct one for your game version. Please note this is not a bug with OBody, it's a problem with your installation.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_reload_config_done: Config reloaded. NPCs that already have a body keep it.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_reload_config_failed: Reload failed, the previous config is still in use:
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_reload_config_hint: Reads the config files again, no restart needed
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_reload_config_skipped: These files were skipped, they couldn't be opened:
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_reroll_all_confirm: Re-roll the presets of all NPCs? {} NPCs nearby change right away, the others the next time they load.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_reroll_all_done: Done: {} NPCs nearby have a new preset, the others get theirs as they load.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_reroll_all_hint: Every NPC gets a new preset, by the config's rules or at random. Manually picked presets stay as they are.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_reroll_hint: OBody picks this NPC's preset again, as if meeting them for the first time, respecting the config's rules if there are any.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_reroll_player: OBody picks your character's preset again, respecting the config's rules if there are any.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_settings_distribution_hint: NPCs that already have a body keep it. Presets can still be picked in the OBody menu.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_settings_master_note: These settings are saved to OBody_presetDistributionConfig.json.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_settings_show_blacklisted: Show blacklisted presets in the OBody menu
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_show_other_bodies: Show presets for other bodies too
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_show_other_bodies_hint: This NPC has a UBE body. Presets made for other bodies can still be picked for them by hand, but they may not look right.
line:menu_translation/obody-ng:interface.$obody_skse_menu_framework_failure: SKSE Menu Framework was not found, which is needed to display the OBody preset selection menu. This means you didn't install SKSE Menu Framework or installed it incorrectly. Please exit the game now and refer to the mod page for instructions.
